2X Match for Moments Like This

Life's best moments should take your breath away, not lung disease. Your gift is DOUBLED through November 30.

Match My Gift

About Us

Founded 120 years ago, the American Lung Association is the leading organization working to save lives by improving lung health and preventing lung disease through education, advocacy and research.

Learn More

Health Education

We provide resources to help countless individuals manage lung diseases, such as asthma, COPD, lung cancer and pulmonary fibrosis. We also help people overcome their addiction to tobacco products and live healthier lives.

Learn More

Federal & State Advocacy

We support laws that put public health first. Policies that improve lung health, reduce tobacco use, protect us from secondhand smoke, and clean up air pollution. Join our network of advocates to make your voice heard.

Learn more

Research

Every year, we fund the best and the brightest in medical and scientific research to drive innovation, discover the unknown, and improve the lives of those living with lung disease.

Learn more

Local Events

Do something healthy and fun with friends while supporting lung health and clean air. Walk, run, cycle, stair-climb a skyscraper, do yoga or raise a toast at a gala. Learn and connect at an educational event or expo.

View Events

2026 State of Lung Cancer Report Released

Our ninth annual "State of Lung Cancer" report finds improved lung cancer survival and higher screening rates. However, challenges remain in ensuring everyone has access to early diagnosis and effective treatment.

View the report

Current Initiatives and Updates

With your help, we're driving lung disease research, protecting youth from vaping, and advancing clean‑air laws. See how these efforts strengthen lung health and save lives every day.

Questions about COPD?

Curious about treatments or ways to live a more active life with COPD? Our Lung Health Navigators are here with free 1:1 support on your schedule.

Read more

Lung Cancer Awareness: Find Your Path

During Lung Cancer Awareness Month, explore Find Your Path, a personalized tool that helps you navigate lung cancer screening and biomarker testing resources based on your unique needs.

Read more

Protect Against Respiratory Illnesses

Taking steps to prevent respiratory illnesses can help keep you and your loved ones healthy. Learn about vaccines, everyday prevention strategies and when to take extra precautions.

Read more

Making an Impact

Your support helps us reach millions of people every year through education, advocacy and research.

0 CENTS

90 cents of every dollar donated goes to program services

90 CENTS

90 cents of every dollar donated goes to program services

Every donation to the American Lung Association supports those affected by lung disease through our programs and services.

225 MILLION

$225 million invested in groundbreaking research since 2000.

225 MILLION

$225 million invested in groundbreaking research since 2000.

We bring together scientific leaders to advance lifesaving research. These critical investments help to fund scientists to unlock new treatments, therapies and cures for lung disease.

35 MILLION

Supporting 35 million people with chronic lung disease.

35 MILLION

Supporting 35 million people with chronic lung disease.

The American Lung Association is the only voluntary health organization dedicated exclusively to supporting 35 million people with chronic lung disease and the 44 million cases of acute respiratory diseases like pneumonia, flu, RSV and COVID-19 each year. 

1+ MILLION

More than a million people have quit with Freedom From Smoking.

1+ MILLION

More than a million people have quit with Freedom From Smoking.

The American Lung Association has helped over one million people quit smoking for good. Freedom From Smoking® is consistently ranked among the most effective cessation programs in the country.

Make a Donation for Every Lung

Every breath matters, whether it's a child with asthma, a parent with COPD or a neighbor facing lung cancer. Help us be there for all of them. Give today.

Help Us Create a World Free of Lung Disease

We are powered by everyday heroes and volunteers. Your support fuels our mission. Participate in an event, volunteer, become an advocate, or donate. Make a difference today.

Stand with LUNG FORCE to Defeat Lung Cancer

Only a force of many can take on lung cancer—the #1 cancer killer in America. LUNG FORCE unites us to stand together and save lives.

Learn about LUNG FORCE

Join the Patient & Caregiver Network

Your community is here to support you. Whether you’re a patient living with a chronic lung disease or a caregiver, join this network to get direct access to timely education, support, and connection.

Join Today

EACH Breath Blog

Go past the headlines as experts, volunteers and staff illustrate the latest discoveries and nuances around healthy lungs and clean air in our award-winning blog.

You Stopped Smoking—Now Start Screening
